messages:
Ivy: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp surfaced a weird combo: dimension drift + repeated batch deliveries when using the Go SDK against the rerank flow. Repro steps below.
Ivy: Command: `go run ./examples/embeds_onboard.go --model=redwood-embed-1024`
Ivy: Observed: some items return 2048-dim vectors, others 1024. Also noticed duplicate ingestion calls in our retriever with different request ids.
Diego: can you paste minimal request/response? any custom headers like x-batcher-id or x-batch-hash?
Ivy: yes. sample: `POST /v1/embeddings body.inputs=3 headers: x-batcher-id=gb-2024-06-77, x-batch-hash=sha256:aaabbb`
Ivy: Response A (Go SDK): `{"data":[{"id":"0","embedding":[...2048...]}, {"id":"1","embedding":[...2048...]}, {"id":"2","embedding":[...1024...]}]}`
Ivy: Response B (Python sampleapp same model string): `{"embeddings":[[...1024...],[...1024...],[...1024...]]}`
Sam: interesting — two issues: 1) some backend route returned a 2048 variant for some shards, 2) Go SDK normalized response into `data[].embedding` shape while Python returns embeddings[] flat.
Nora: also saw in logs: `auth: token_refresh -> replay request -> dropped x-batch-hash header on replay`. Server accepted replay as new batch because header missing.
Diego: so duplicates are from missing batch-hash on retry, dims mismatch from mixed model routing. Any client-side checksum validation?
Ivy: sampleapp uses the batch helper which computes a checksum and sends x-batch-hash. The Go SDK retry code path wasn't copying custom headers on internal retries. Repro: flip network between auth refresh and retry to reproduce.
Sam: low-frequency but real impact: retriever index gets duplicate vector inserts and ranking changes. customers saw transient score jumps.
Nora: quick mitigations: 1) sampleapp patch to normalize both envelope shapes into canonical embeddings[] and stable id ordering, 2) if checksum header missing on retry, reject and surface a clear error instead of silently retrying.
Diego: long-term: SDKs must preserve all outbound headers during internal retry. Also runtime should bucket model variants by alias and warn when alias maps to multiple dims.
Ivy: created PR for sampleapp normalization + guard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/529 (adds adapter to accept `data[].embedding` and `embeddings[]`, plus checksum enforcement).
Sam: filed SDK issue to copy headers on retry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1024 (assigning to go-sdk).
Nora: ops-bot: created incident INC-2024-1844 (eng-runtime, go-sdk)
ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-1844 created, severity=low, owner=eng-runtime
Diego: tests to add: cross-language parity check (Go/Python/Node) that asserts vector dims + envelope shape for a small set of canonical prompts; and network-fault test ensuring x-batch-hash survives auth refresh.
Ivy: logging note: add batch-hash to server audit logs to aid dedupe when header missing.
Sam: thumbs-up. keeping thread pinned to the onboarding issue. If you see strange rerank deltas in prod, drop a note here and tag eng-runtime. :eyes:
